requirements.text: Send automated reminders to customers 24 hours and 1 hour before their appointments
Allow customers to book appointments online at any time
Customers must be able to choose from various services including haircuts, beard trims, hair coloring, shaves, and kids' cuts
Customers should be able to select their preferred barber when booking
Barbers must be able to log into the system to update their availability
Barbers should be able to mark days off and set their working hours
Barbers must be able to block out specific times in their schedule
Provide daily and weekly summaries of total bookings, cancellations, no-shows, peak times, and customer preferences
System must prevent double bookings to avoid confusion
Reports must be easy to read and interpret for decision-making
